traits.admission: How reliably the meeting platform admits the session (bot detection rejects automated browsers).
traits.unattended: Runs with no operator-loaded browser extension or signed-in browser.
traits.real_meeting: Joins a real remote meeting (the stub and in-room drivers do not).

evidence: libs/core/browser/chrome-extension-meeting-driver.ts (drives the operator's signed-in Chrome through the Meet Copilot extension over a loopback WS; exists because Playwright/CDP sessions are rejected by Google Meet's bot detection)
libs/actuators/meeting-actuator/src/meeting-session.ts (runRegisteredJoinDriver runtime default before this policy: 'chrome-extension'; join_backend 'auto' also maps to it)
libs/actuators/meeting-browser-driver/src/index.ts (Playwright/CDP browser driver; unattended, but subject to platform bot detection)
scripts/meeting/meeting_participate.ts (previous CLI --driver default before this policy)
libs/core/meeting/in-room-meeting-driver.ts (supported_platforms ['in_room']: local microphone/speaker for a physical-room meeting, no URL)
libs/core/meeting/meeting-join-driver.ts (StubMeetingJoinDriver over a StubAudioBus; tests and the CLI fallback when the chosen driver is unavailable)

attended.description: Join a real remote meeting as the operator's delegate with the best admission odds.

unattended.description: Join a real remote meeting with no operator browser or extension present.
